identity.name: OpenMM 8.2.0 DHFR PME fixed-work replica ensemble
identity.brief_variant: Eight sequential independent replicas; candidate concurrency with MPS on the same single GPU.
identity.provenance_limit: Fixed-work dhfr_ensemble.py is supplied in the brief, not verified at a public URL. Public benchmark.py provides the system and executable published throughput benchmark.
